summary: Waddle Play iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite for new endpoints: 9/9 passed (forum list+detail, resources list, threads list+detail, POST /threads/{id}/messages appends from=me and resets unread to 0, notifications list + read-all, profile PUT persistence). Frontend Expo web preview mobile viewport (390x844): Sign-in with demo creds works. Home shows TopBar (topbar-notifications/settings/profile) + quick-nav grid (quick-forum/resources/playdates/explore) - all 7 testIDs visible. Explore sub-tabs (explore-tab-list/map) work, Map renders 5 pins with testIDs map-pin-*, tapping a pin opens map-bubble with View + close X which correctly dismisses. Playdates tab: pd-tab-upcoming/past switch lists (2 rows each). Messages tab: 4 threads (thread-*); tapping opens chat with chat-name/input/send; sending 'Hello from test' appends message AND clears input (verified). Notifications page: 5 rows, notifications-read-all clickable. Forum: forum-search visible, 5 topics + 5 posts, forum-back returns to /. Resources: resources-search, 4 kind chips, 5 resource-* rows. Settings page: settings-edit-profile + settings-signout visible. Profile Edit: edit-name/location/bio/save + 28 edit-chip-* toggles present; edit-save persists via PUT /api/profile/me and navigates back to /settings. All critical review items verified working.
action_items: None required - all review items verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 750+ lines is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting seed data into a separate module (seed.py) and each feature area (forum/resources/threads/notifications) into routers.
Deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') still in use (also noted iter 1) - consider lifespan context manager.
POST /notifications/read-all marks ALL notifications globally as read (uses update_many({}, ...)) rather than per-user. Fine for a demo but not multi-user safe.

POST /threads/{id}/messages does not verify that the current user owns/belongs to the thread; any authenticated user can post to any thread. Fine for demo (single threads collection) but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo user + seeded forum/resources/threads/notifications. Chat send test appended one 'TEST_message from pytest' message to th-lisa and one 'Hello from test' to th-sarah (harmless). Profile PUT test set demo user's bio/location to TEST_* values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All new endpoints under /api: /forum, /forum/{id}, /resources, /threads, /threads/{id}, /threads/{id}/messages (POST), /notifications, /notifications/read-all (POST). Threads and notifications are global (shared across users) — do not assume per-user isolation. Frontend routes: /forum, /resources, /notifications, /settings, /profile/edit, /messages/[id], plus tabs / /explore /playdates /messages. edit-chip-* testIDs number ~28 (values + sensory + interests chips combined).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 14 review items verified end-to-end.
